pr_title: Adjust judgement animations to match stable
pr_body:
This adds complete coverage of new and old style legacy skin judgements. Until now, we were applying a single set of transforms (based on lazer's default skin) across the board, as it was a bit difficulty to correctly insert the transforms in place (resolved in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/10878).

Particles are still not implemented; that will come in a follow-up PR.

- [x] Depends on #10878 
- [x] Depends on #10889
- Closes #10172
- Closes #10195
pr_comments: Looks good to go in for now as far as I can tell, although I'm still a little curious if the `IDrawable` stuff can be simplified/de-cast.

issue_context.title: For legacy skins, judgements should use animations that match stable
issue_context.body:
Re-opening #6420 under this name

**Describe the bug:** 
Legacy skin judgements use different animation effects on stable than they do on lazer. On lazer they pop out from middle regardless of if the judgements are animated or not, on stable they fade in if they are animated and only pop out if not.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
https://youtu.be/Je50_IcAmFs
lazer is on left, stable on right, using [my skin](https://github.com/LittleEndu/osuSkin/tree/master/u200B)

**osu!lazer version:** 
2020.910.0

review_comments: I suppose that's going to be a separate pull?
at some point, not imminently planned though. i'm just fixing osu! rule set for now.
I'd propose adding lifetime members to `IDrawable` in framework to avoid this casting, but not sure if worth just for this / in line with intentions for that interface...
yeah, was disappointed it wasn't there. @smoogipoo any reason these properties don't exists in the interface already?
I'd be fine with that, but I don't think it blocks this PR from merge.
